description: ONE ACTIVITY'S COST REACHING ONE COST OBJECT, with every number the quotient was built from. `driver_quantity` and `driver_share` are stored beside `assigned_amount` rather than recomputed on read, because the driver quantity somebody measured in March is a fact about March, and a report that re-derived it from today's Field table would quietly restate a prior year. `cost_per_acre` is null — never zero — where the block had no productive acres in the period: zero is a per-acre figure for a division nobody performed.

fields.description: The activity's name as it stood when the run happened. Denormalised on purpose: a renamed or deleted activity must not make a stored allocation unreadable.
fields.label: Activity Name

fields.description: Which block the cost reached. Data rather than a Link so a retired block still reads back.
fields.label: Cost Object

fields.description: How much of the driver this cost object consumed — acres, hours, applications, bins.
fields.label: Driver Quantity

fields.description: This object's share of the activity's total driver quantity, as a percentage. The shares within one activity sum to 100.
fields.label: Driver Share %

fields.description: The whole pool this line drew from, carried on every line so a single row can be read without its siblings.
fields.label: Pool Amount

fields.description: This block's time-weighted productive acres in the period — the denominator of `cost_per_acre`, stored so the quotient can be checked without recomputing the year.
fields.label: Productive Acres

fields.description: WHETHER THE DRIVER QUANTITY WAS MEASURED OR DERIVED, in words. The column that tells a reader which half of this report is evidence and which half is arithmetic over the Field table.
fields.label: Driver Source

name: ABC Cost Assignment Line
